title: Best Friends RV Park

services.name: RV site 1
services.desc: Each of our 18 RV sites comes with a picnic table, 35-foot concrete slab, power, septic, water hookups, and Wi-Fi, making them perfect for both short-term visits and extended stays. Explore nearby hiking trails, and enjoy easy access to three national parks (Zion, Bryce Canyon, and North Rim Grand Canyon) within just a 90-minute drive. Please note that RVs longer than 21 feet have difficulty maneuvering some of the Sanctuary roads and parking areas, so if your RV is longer than 21 feet, you'll need a car to get around the Sanctuary.
